name: documented-skill-contract
description: Extracts and classifies every hyperlink from SharePoint page or document content -- absolute, server-relative, protocol-relative, mailto, anchor, and malformed -- into a LinkInventory carrying an honest outcome (OBSERVED / EMPTY / PARTIAL / FAILED). Read-only; reads content you pass it and never contacts a tenant.
prompt: Use the extract-links skill according to its SKILL.md. State the expected inputs, outputs, safety boundaries, and what the skill must not do.
expected: Uses the skill documented in SKILL.md
Identifies the required input artifacts or parameters
Identifies the expected output or report artifact
Respects the documented plugin boundaries and non-responsibilities
Does not invent destructive tenant writes or bypass required confirmation gates
